items.title: Task classifier: repro-first-required vs bypass-eligible from type/priority/riskSignals (conservative, warn-on-uncertain)
items.context: New classifier (e.g. in a core helper) deciding repro-first-required (type=bug OR high-risk riskSignal class OR code-verifiable runtime/CLI/gate behavior change) vs bypass-eligible (doc/metadata/registry-only chore, explicit quick-fix flag, low-confidence). Conservative: ambiguous doc/chore -> bypass-eligible; uncertain high-risk -> warn (never block). Pure function over the story-create inputs already available (type, priority, riskSignals, title, description, keywords).
items.userSees: Classifier keeps documentation-only stories moving, while code/gate/proof stories are marked repro-first-required before lifecycle advance.

happy.desc: A checklist that declares code file changes is treated as requiring repro-first binding before PLAN/DEV.

edge.desc: A checklist with no files.modify/create/test remains bypass-eligible and is not blocked by repro-first gate.

adversarial.desc: A code-touched story cannot bypass by providing a malformed or stale story-evidence-binding.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke ok 1/4/9 proves file-declaring stories are classified repro-first-required and blocked without binding under enforce mode.
Smoke ok 3 proves no-file checklist stories remain bypass-eligible and get no PLAN guard failure.
Smoke ok 8 and ok 11 prove unaccepted-review and stale-digest bindings are rejected instead of trusted as bypass metadata.

items.title: STORY_INTAKE preflight in story-create.ts + story_create_from_repro: query proof-admissibility for a bound accepted repro/spike evidence-candidate; warn/block; fail-OPEN; bypass-with-reason
items.context: Add the preflight to packages/main/src/handlers/story-create.ts (and ensure story_create_from_repro passes because it binds the candidate). REUSE proof-admissibility (STORY_INTAKE consumer, evidence-candidate scope). Satisfied = a bound reviewer-accepted candidate: repro path (repro-probe + repro-review reviewedFailureClass=target-bug) OR spike path (spike-record + spike-review). Required+missing -> warn (block under enforce) with exact next command. Wrap the whole preflight in fail-OPEN try/catch (engine error -> allow + repro_first_preflight_engine_error diagnostic). Bypass (bypassReproFirst.reason) always honored, writes a repro-first-bypass local-diagnostic artifact.
items.userSees: When a code-touched story lacks accepted repro evidence, the terminal prints Cannot enter PLAN or Cannot enter DEV with missing_story_evidence_binding and the recovery command hint.

happy.desc: PLAN→DEV and INIT_CHECK→DEV express are allowed when a valid story-evidence-binding references a red-reviewed target-bug repro.

edge.desc: IDEA→PLAN is blocked for file-touched stories with no binding and surfaces a precise missing_story_evidence_binding reason.

adversarial.desc: Bindings with stale probe/review digests or mismatched story identity are rejected before PLAN/DEV entry.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke ok 2, ok 10, and ok 13 prove valid story-evidence-binding allows IDEA→PLAN, PLAN→DEV, and INIT_CHECK→DEV express.
Smoke ok 1 and ok 9 prove file-touched stories without binding surface missing_story_evidence_binding before PLAN/DEV.
Smoke ok 8 and ok 11 prove stale digests, unaccepted reviews, and non-target-bug classifications are rejected before PLAN/DEV entry.
Existing candidate workflow still creates story-evidence-binding without verificationEvidence after createStoryFromRepro changes.

items.title: Config reproFirstPreflight.mode=off|warn|enforce (warn default) + reason codes + process fact + session_brief surfacing
items.context: Resolve reproFirstPreflight.mode (off|warn|enforce, default warn) mirroring proofAdmissibility.mode. Add reason codes repro_first_required_no_candidate, repro_first_candidate_unreviewed, repro_first_reviewed_class_not_target_bug, repro_first_bypassed, repro_first_preflight_engine_error. Register process fact runtime:repro_first_intake_preflight (STORY_INTAKE consumer), synchronized with the admissibility/process-fact verification script. session_brief shows per active story: reproFirst: bound-accepted | bypassed(reason) | missing.
items.userSees: The gate failure text distinguishes missing, invalid, stale, and non-code-bypass cases without claiming Authority or production evidence.

happy.desc: Failure reasons include missing_story_evidence_binding and stale_story_evidence_binding for the corresponding gate outcomes.

edge.desc: No-file checklist stories return null guard failure reason and continue normally.

adversarial.desc: The gate validates artifact digests and accepted repro review semantics instead of trusting local prose or arbitrary metadata.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke ok 1/9/11 proves missing_story_evidence_binding and stale_story_evidence_binding are emitted for missing and stale gate outcomes.
Smoke ok 3 proves no-file checklist stories return null guard failure reason and continue normally.
Smoke ok 8 proves gate checks artifact digests plus repro review verdict/class semantics instead of trusting arbitrary local metadata.
Process fact contract verified runtime:repro_first_story_intake_preflight and story-evidence-binding artifact registration.

items.title: Hermetic smoke covering the verification matrix; register
items.context: check+counter smoke (explicit literals) covering: type=bug no candidate -> warn (mode=warn) and block (mode=enforce) with next command; story_create_from_repro with accepted target-bug repro-review -> pass; candidate present but repro-review missing -> repro_first_candidate_unreviewed; reviewer class bootstrap-noise -> repro_first_reviewed_class_not_target_bug; spike path accepted -> pass; doc-only chore -> allow; bypassReproFirst.reason -> allow + repro-first-bypass artifact + session_brief; classifier throws -> allow + repro_first_preflight_engine_error (fail-open); mode=off -> allow always. Register the smoke in the validate command set / package test script.
